expectations.text: The AI gives the Improve message on its own (it may name the workflow) and starts no interview, design, build or test work
expectations.evidence: The AI explained that Weekly Status Report is in production with a pending Tune ("Say 'continue my workflow' with Weekly Status Report... The next step there is Build's fix mode"). It did not stop there. It went on to start a new interview: it opened a new Deconstruct ("This is the most thorough conversation in the framework... It has five parts"), listed candidates from the opportunity report, and asked "Which workflow from your report do you want to map?" That is new interview/design work, not the Improve message on its own.
